🔥 Riya Ranjan is a graduate of Stanford University , leaving with a degree in computer science and mathematics. While at Stanford, she conducted research on AI evaluations for legal workflows, and technology design ethics, particularly around deepfake sexual violence. Her work has been presented and published in top legal and AI research venues, including #NeurIPS and #ICAIL . Her current research focuses on applying voice AI to access to justice issues. 👀 LLMxLaw Conference: https://lnkd.in/dHzecFxn 📅 Saturday, June 27th, 2026 📍 Cambridge Judge Business School ➡️ Register: https://lnkd.in/dgMq-qJK Organised by King's E-Lab , Cambridge Judge Business School and Clifford Chance

This launch ended up overlapping with a planned vacation. Watching Artemis II go to the moon while sitting aboard a ship at sea that would have been unfathomable 150 years ago makes me excited for what the future may bring. I can't wait until people are gathering for dinner on cruise ships to the moon and Mars!

After finishing up my classes at Stanford AeroAstro last week, I'm beyond ecstatic to share that I'm joining the Starship GNC team at SpaceX in Starbase, TX. This has been a long time in the making and I can't wait to get humanity to the Moon, Mars and Beyond!

At the end of October, I was honored to present my team's research from the Stanford Intelligent Systems Laboratory at the 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)! Our research focuses on how AI agents could improve pilots' situational awareness in emergencies or high-workload scenarios. Our paper titled LeRAAT: LLM-Enabled Real-Time Aviation Advisory Tool was published by the conference and is available here: https://lnkd.in/guvqBHHM

✨ Big news today! ✨ I’m incredibly excited to announce the launch of Daydream in the U.S. App Store! I’m so proud of how hard our team worked to bring this to life. We partnered closely with Apple to build an experience designed entirely for iOS 26, fully embracing the new design language and the liquid glass aesthetic. We’re also Visual Intelligence–ready — meaning you can take a screenshot of any outfit you see anywhere and search with it instantly using Daydream. It’s a completely new way to discover and shop. 📲 Download the app and make all of your shopping dreams come true.

🌕 Sims today, Lunar South Pole soon We’re getting close to the final stretch of training for our first Blue Moon MK1 mission. This month, we’re running end-to-end, high-fidelity simulations of several mission phases —launch, apogee‑raise burn, lunar orbit insertion, descent orbit insertion, landing, and surface ops. From our lunar Mission Control in Washington, controllers execute real procedures, send commands into a flight‑representative sim, and read telemetry from an emulation of the global network of ground stations and satellites we’ll use during the flight.

Starship's tenth test flight marked a significant step forward in developing the world's first fully reusable launch vehicle. Our engineering team at Starbase is tackling tough design and manufacturing challenges to enable rapid reusability and on-orbit refueling, paving the way for long-duration spaceflight to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We are hiring engineers who want to push the boundaries of what's possible! Apply below if you want to join the Starbase team making this happen. https://lnkd.in/gRt_XGXp https://lnkd.in/gbrEzZT9 https://lnkd.in/gzUpar-7
